state.description: The state of the status, often translated to icon type/ color. This varies by git service provider.

externalLink.description: A link to an external process or UI that can provide more information about the status.

description.description: The description of the status. Often shows up as a longer 1 line string describing the process producing the status.

name.description: The name or category of this status which often shows up as a 1 word way to differentiate between statuses.

sha.description: The commit to post this status too. Services will associate the status with a pull request based off the commit.

title:
Holds information about a {@link SourceControlCommit}'s status. For most git services, this equates to the icon you
see on PR's that contains a link to CI.
name: SourceControlCommitStatus
